meta.title: Learn Pi Agent
meta.description: Agent harness engineering with pi: agency comes from the model, the harness comes from you

home.hero_subtitle: Real agent harness engineering. pi already turns the loop; you just hang mechanisms on it.
home.core_pattern_desc: pi runs the same loop inside: call the model, run tools, feed results back. Your job is to hang mechanisms on that loop — tools, permission, events, knowledge, sessions, delegation, integration.
home.learning_path_desc: 12 progressive chapters, from a single minimal session to many mechanisms in one AgentSession
home.layers_desc: Four orthogonal concerns combine into a complete harness

timeline.title: Learning path
timeline.subtitle: s01 to s12: hang your own mechanisms on pi's loop

layers.title: Mechanism layers
layers.subtitle: Four orthogonal concerns combine into a complete harness
layers.loop: Loop and action. pi ships the agent loop; here you give it hands, draw a boundary, and hang hooks on it.
layers.knowledge: Knowledge and context. On-demand skills, prompt templates, session branching and compaction are all, at heart, managing a finite context.
layers.delegate: Delegation and integration. Isolate tasks with subagents, drive pi across processes with RPC, and connect any model with a custom provider.
layers.distribute: Distribution and integration. Pack tools, skills, and templates into one installable unit, then assemble the machine.
